# NOMEN

NOMEN inspects ERC-8004 registry snapshots. Passing is a metadata-rule result, not a safety endorsement.

- Docs: /docs
- Free single lookup: /api/snapshot?chain=sepolia&agentId=2364
- Bulk lookup: POST /api/toplu with JSON {"chain":"sepolia","agentIds":[2364,6815]}; at most 2000 positive safe integers, body <=64 KiB.
- Provenance: /veri/ozet.json
- Published Merkle proofs: /veri/sepolia/merkle.json
- Live Graph activity: /api/activity?agentId=2364 (503 when not configured)

Snapshot chains: ethereum, sepolia, arbitrum, arc. App and AI discovery use only sepolia, arbitrum and arc. not_scanned and rpc_error mean unknown. HTTP metadata was observed at scan time, not verified live. Legacy Ethereum scan timestamps are unverified. The 249 listed Arc records were refreshed September 11, 2026 at block 61552064; non-listed Arc records retain legacy observations. Naming is Sepolia-only under nomen-demo.eth. Replacement contracts and a real claim were verified on September 11, 2026. GET /api/activity?chain=sepolia&agentId=10226 returns Graph-indexed events with explicit freshness; indexing delays are not evidence of absence.

AI discovery: POST /api/discover with an English request of 15–500 characters and chain all, sepolia, arbitrum or arc. Requires fresh Graph owner and metadata-URI continuity against the snapshot block before AI ranking. Includes registry coverage and AI-selected registrySignals. Stale/unavailable evidence withholds candidates on the affected network. Arc is scoped to the 249 listed catalog IDs. registry.networks reports each network separately; Ethereum is excluded from AI discovery; Arbitrum uses snapshot capabilities plus live trial history. No feedback count establishes performance.

Complaint records: /orders. Structured complaints cost 5 test USDC (native, 18 decimals) on Arc Testnet, not real USD. GET /api/complaints lists published records; POST accepts signed prepare/publish/edit/reply/status actions. Exact schemas and consent message: lib/complaints.ts. Payment commits the original draft. Updates and provider replies are free; author alone resolves/reopens. Current registry ownership is required for provider responses. Payment is not purchase verification or proof of truth. No complaints means no recorded complaints, not good performance. Demo records are excluded from counts. POST /api/reviews is retired (410); GET remains a historical read-only archive.
ENS naming remains at /claim under nomen-demo.eth on Sepolia; registered names at /names.

Wallet connection: choose an EIP-6963 browser wallet from Connect wallet. Full reloads require reconnecting; app navigation preserves the session. No QR bridge is configured. New public trial receipt publication is not offered by the workbench; historical Arbitrum receipts remain readable and inform matching.
